mainEntity.name: How much time should we keep for Ram Janmabhoomi security checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plan 60–75 minutes from parking bay to sanctum on regular days; weekends and festivals can stretch to 90 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What items are banned inside Ram Janmabhoomi complex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bags above 12 inches, liquids, power banks, large prasad boxes, and metal pooja items are disallowed. Phones must stay on silent.

mainEntity.name: Do you arrange lockers for valuables?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we book Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Trust lockers at Gate 3 and issue tamper-proof tags for each group.

mainEntity.name: What is the fare for this security-focused package?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing starts at ₹14,800 for a 12 seater including security liaison and queue monitoring support.
